$comment: Declarative Metabase database-connection manifest. Secrets are referenced by ${ENV_VAR} name only (resolved from the repo-root .env at run time) so this file is safe to commit. Connections are matched/updated by 'name'. Run: make metabase-provision

databases.name: ClickHouse Cloud - SC
databases._note: Cost control via sync throttling: NO field-value scans (is_full_sync=false) and metadata sync moved to daily, so Metabase's background jobs don't quietly bill ClickHouse. NOTE: Layer A (server-side query cache) CANNOT be set through the Metabase driver — `additional-options` is stored but NOT applied as a ClickHouse setting (verified: use_query_cache stayed 0). To enable it, set it on the ClickHouse side instead, e.g.: ALTER USER <user> SETTINGS use_query_cache = 1, query_cache_ttl = 1800;

global_cache._note: Layer B: OSS global adaptive query cache (root policy). Requires MB_ENABLE_QUERY_CACHING=true (set in docker-compose). A result's TTL ≈ query_runtime_ms × multiplier, only for queries that ran at least min_duration_ms. Applied via PUT /api/cache by the provision script. This is heuristic, NOT a fixed 30-min window (that is Pro-only).
